You are in a Linux container. The Go repository github.com/labstack/echo/v4 is checked out at /echo. Do NOT modify any files. Your job is only to gather baseline information and report it.

1. Run `cd /echo && go version` and `cd /echo && cat go.mod`.
2. Run the full test suite: `cd /echo && go test ./... 2>&1 | tail -50` and also `cd /echo && go test ./middleware/ 2>&1 | tail -60`.
3. Report the exact list of any FAILING tests (package + test name + failure message), and confirm which packages pass. If everything passes, say so explicitly.
4. Also report whether `go vet ./middleware/` reports anything.

Report concisely: go version, test results per package, exact names of failing tests, and any build errors.

You are working in a Linux container. A Go repository (github.com/labstack/echo/v4) is checked out at /echo. Fix a bug in /echo/middleware/proxy.go and verify it.

BUG: When a ProxyBalancer has no targets, the proxy middleware panics at request time instead of responding with an error. Specifically:
- `randomBalancer.Next` does `b.targets[b.random.Intn(len(b.targets))]` -> panics with "index out of range" when len(targets)==0.
- `roundRobinBalancer.Next` does `b.i = b.i % uint32(len(b.targets))` -> panics with "integer divide by zero" when len(targets)==0.
- `ProxyWithConfig`'s returned handler uses the target without a nil check.

EXPECTED BEHAVIOUR (this is what the hidden test `middleware::TestProxyBalancerWithNoTargets` checks): constructing a balancer with no targets (e.g. `NewRandomBalancer(nil)` or `NewRoundRobinBalancer(nil)`), installing it via `e.Use(Proxy(rb))`, and serving a GET request must NOT panic and must produce HTTP status 503 (http.StatusServiceUnavailable).

REQUIRED EDITS (only in /echo/middleware/proxy.go; do not touch any other file):
1. In `randomBalancer.Next`: after the `b.random == nil` init and after acquiring `b.mutex.RLock()`, add `if len(b.targets) == 0 { return nil }` before indexing.
2. In `roundRobinBalancer.Next`: acquire `b.mutex.RLock()` / `defer b.mutex.RUnlock()` at the start, add `if len(b.targets) == 0 { return nil }`, then keep the existing modulo/index/atomic increment logic.
3. In `ProxyWithConfig`'s inner handler, right after `tgt := config.Balancer.Next(c)`, add:
```go
			if tgt == nil {
				return echo.ErrServiceUnavailable
			}
```
   (before `c.Set(config.ContextKey, tgt)`).

Keep the code gofmt-formatted and do not change any other behaviour, comments, or files.

VERIFICATION (do all of it):
- `cd /echo && gofmt -l middleware/proxy.go` (must print nothing) and `cd /echo && go build ./... && go vet ./middleware/`.
- Create a TEMPORARY test file /echo/middleware/zz_tmp_notargets_test.go in package `middleware` containing a test named `TestTmpProxyBalancerWithNoTargets` that does, for both `NewRandomBalancer(nil)` and `NewRoundRobinBalancer(nil)`: build `e := echo.New()`, `e.Use(Proxy(rb))`, `req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil)`, `rec := httptest.NewRecorder()`, `e.ServeHTTP(rec, req)`, and assert `rec.Code == http.StatusServiceUnavailable` (use github.com/stretchr/testify/assert). Run `cd /echo && go test ./middleware/ -run TestTmpProxyBalancerWithNoTargets -v` and confirm it PASSES. Also confirm that before your fix it would have panicked (you may reason about it, no need to revert).
- Run the whole middleware package test suite: `cd /echo && go test ./middleware/ 2>&1 | tail -30` and also `cd /echo && go test ./... 2>&1 | tail -30`. All pre-existing tests must still pass.
- IMPORTANT: DELETE the temporary test file /echo/middleware/zz_tmp_notargets_test.go afterwards and re-run `cd /echo && go test ./middleware/ 2>&1 | tail -20` to confirm everything still passes. The final state of the repository must contain NO new test files and no leftover temp files (`cd /echo && git status --porcelain` should show only `middleware/proxy.go` modified).

REPORT: the exact diff of middleware/proxy.go (`cd /echo && git diff`), the test output summary (pass/fail counts, names of any failing tests), and confirmation that git status shows only middleware/proxy.go modified.

You are verifying a bug fix in a Go repository checked out at /echo (github.com/labstack/echo/v4). Do NOT change any non-test source file; your job is verification only.

Context: middleware/proxy.go was just patched so that a ProxyBalancer with zero targets no longer panics: `randomBalancer.Next` and `roundRobinBalancer.Next` return nil when `len(b.targets) == 0`, and `ProxyWithConfig`'s handler returns `echo.ErrServiceUnavailable` when the selected target is nil.

Do this:
1. `cd /echo && git diff` and `cd /echo && git status --porcelain` — report them verbatim. Confirm the only modified file is middleware/proxy.go and that there are no untracked files.
2. `cd /echo && gofmt -l . && go build ./... && go vet ./...` — report output/exit codes.
3. Create a TEMPORARY test file /echo/middleware/zz_verify_notargets_test.go (package middleware) defining ONE test function named `TestVerifyNoTargetsReturns503` (use exactly this name; do NOT use the name TestProxyBalancerWithNoTargets). In it, for each of `NewRandomBalancer(nil)`, `NewRoundRobinBalancer(nil)`, and also a round-robin balancer whose only target was removed via RemoveTarget (i.e. `b := NewRoundRobinBalancer([]*ProxyTarget{{Name: "t", URL: u}}); b.RemoveTarget("t")` with `u, _ := url.Parse("http://127.0.0.1:1")`), do: `e := echo.New(); e.Use(Proxy(b)); req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil); rec := httptest.NewRecorder(); e.ServeHTTP(rec, req)` and assert `rec.Code == http.StatusServiceUnavailable` (503). Also assert that a random balancer with 2 real targets still proxies fine is NOT needed. Run `cd /echo && go test ./middleware/ -run TestVerifyNoTargetsReturns503 -v -count=1` and report the output.
4. Run the FULL suites and report results: `cd /echo && go test ./... -count=1 2>&1 | tail -20` and `cd /echo && go test ./middleware/ -count=1 -v 2>&1 | grep -E "^(--- )?(FAIL|SKIP|ok|PASS)" | sort | uniq -c | head -20` plus `cd /echo && go test ./middleware/ -count=1 2>&1 | grep -c FAIL`.
5. Run `cd /echo && go test -race ./middleware/ -count=1 2>&1 | tail -10` to make sure no data races are introduced by the new RLock in roundRobinBalancer.Next.
6. DELETE /echo/middleware/zz_verify_notargets_test.go, then re-run `cd /echo && go test ./... -count=1 2>&1 | tail -10` and `cd /echo && git status --porcelain` and confirm only middleware/proxy.go is modified and no untracked files remain.

REPORT: verbatim git diff/status, exact test commands and their pass/fail summaries, the list of any failing test names, and a clear final verdict on whether the fix works and whether any pre-existing test broke.

Go repo github.com/labstack/echo/v4 at /echo. Find and fix ONE injected bug in /echo/group.go. Do not modify other files; do not modify existing tests.

CLUE: a hidden test named `TestMultipleGroupSamePathMiddleware` (package echo, in group_test.go) is expected to pass after the fix. The name describes the expected behaviour: when MULTIPLE groups share the SAME path/prefix, each group's middleware must be applied correctly to its own routes (and the group whose route is actually matched must be the one whose middleware runs; middleware from other same-path groups must not run).

METHOD:
1. Read /echo/group.go fully, plus /echo/echo.go (Echo.Group, Echo.add, Echo.Use, applyMiddleware) and /echo/router.go (Router.Add).
2. The likely upstream implementation of `Group.Use` is:
```go
func (g *Group) Use(middleware ...MiddlewareFunc) {
	g.middleware = append(g.middleware, middleware...)
	if len(g.middleware) == 0 {
		return
	}
	// Allow all requests to reach the group as they might get dropped if router
	// doesn't find a match, making none of the group middleware process.
	g.Any("", NotFoundHandler)
	g.Any("/*", NotFoundHandler)
}
```
and `Group.Add` must build a FRESH middleware slice (`make([]MiddlewareFunc, 0, len(g.middleware)+len(middleware))`, append group middleware then route middleware) before calling `g.echo.add(g.host, method, g.prefix+path, handler, m...)`. Check every function in group.go for a subtle deviation (wrong slice, wrong append order, missing copy, wrong prefix concatenation, wrong condition, wrong host propagation, wrong middleware passed to Any/Match).
3. Write a TEMPORARY test file /echo/zz_tmp_group_test.go (package echo) with a test `TestTmpMultipleGroupSamePathMiddleware` that reproduces the scenario: two groups with the same prefix and different middleware, each registering a route at the same sub-path with its own route middleware; record the execution order of the middlewares in a slice and log it; also test a request to an unmatched sub-path under the prefix, and a request to the bare prefix. Use `e.ServeHTTP` with httptest. Print/log the observed order and status codes for each scenario. Determine which observations are WRONG (e.g. middleware of the wrong group running, missing middleware, duplicated middleware, panic, wrong status).
4. Fix the bug in /echo/group.go with the minimal change that makes the behaviour correct, then verify: `cd /echo && gofmt -l group.go` (empty), `go build ./... && go vet ./...`, `go test . -run 'TestGroup' -v -count=1 2>&1 | tail -40`, and the full suite `go test ./... -count=1 2>&1 | tail -20` (all must be ok; other pre-existing modified files context.go, middleware/proxy.go, bind.go must be left alone).
5. DELETE /echo/zz_tmp_group_test.go and re-run `go test ./... -count=1 2>&1 | tail -10` and `git status --porcelain` (no untracked files).

REPORT: the observed behaviour of each scenario, the exact bug you identified, the final `git diff group.go` (or state no bug found), test outputs and git status.

Go repo github.com/labstack/echo/v4 at /echo. Find and fix ONE injected bug in /echo/router.go. Do not modify other files; do not modify existing tests.

CLUE: a hidden test named `TestRouterNoRoutablePath` (package echo, in router_test.go) is expected to pass after the fix. The name describes the expected behaviour: routing a request whose path has no routable match must behave sanely (no panic, correct 404/405 handler, correct context path/params).

METHOD (be systematic, this is a bug-hunt):
1. Read /echo/router.go fully (Router.Add, node.insert, node.findStaticChild/findChildWithLabel/addStaticChild, node.findHandler, checkMethodNotAllowed, Router.Find) and /echo/echo.go (ServeHTTP, add, GetPath) and /echo/context.go (Reset, pvalues).
2. Look for a subtle deviation from correct router behaviour: wrong slice index/bound, wrong comparison, missing/extra guard, wrong node kind priority, wrong searchIndex/paramIndex bookkeeping, wrong ppath/pnames handling.
3. Write a TEMPORARY test file /echo/zz_tmp_router_test.go (package echo) that FUZZES the router for panics and wrong behaviour: register many route-set combinations (e.g. "/", "/foo", "/foo/bar", "/:id", "/:id/:id2", "/*", "/foo/*", "/foo/:id", "/foo/:id/bar", mixed), then call `e.ServeHTTP` (and/or `e.router.Find(method, path, c)` directly) with many request paths ("", "/", "//", "/foo", "/foo/", "/foo/bar", "/foo/bar/", "/foo/baz", "/:id", "/foo/:id", "*", "/a/b/c/d", paths not starting with '/', paths with trailing slash, percent-encoded paths) and for several methods. Recover from panics and print the route set + path + method + panic value. Report every panic found.
4. Also check for wrong results: e.g. a registered route that is never matched, a request that should be 404 returning 405 or vice versa, wrong `c.Param` values, wrong `c.Path()`.
5. If you find a concrete bug (especially a panic, or a clear wrong-match), fix it in /echo/router.go with the MINIMAL change that makes behaviour correct, then verify: `cd /echo && gofmt -l router.go` (empty), `go build ./... && go vet ./...`, `go test ./... -count=1 2>&1 | tail -20` (all packages must be ok; there are pre-existing modified files context.go, middleware/proxy.go, bind.go — leave them alone).
6. DELETE /echo/zz_tmp_router_test.go when done and re-run `go test ./... -count=1 2>&1 | tail -10` and `git status --porcelain` (no untracked files).

REPORT: what you found (with the exact reproducing route set/path/method and observed vs expected), the final `git diff router.go` (or state that no bug was found and router.go is unchanged), test outputs, and git status.
